exposure: Obstetricians' beliefs about cesarean delivery on maternal request
pregnant women's decision to choose cesarean section
measures to decrease cesarean section at hospitals
Hospital measures to decrease cesarean section rates
Obstetricians' attitudes towards cesarean delivery on maternal request
outcome: Obstetricians' likelihood of performing cesarean delivery on maternal request
finding: Obstetricians who agreed with cesarean delivery on maternal request and believed its benefits outweighed the risks were more likely to perform it, while hospital measures to decrease cesarean sections were associated with a reduced likelihood.
mod_finding: This study focuses on obstetricians' attitudes and practices regarding cesarean delivery on maternal request, exploring factors influencing their decisions.
